proposition.claim:
Lemma 4.7 Gaussian integration by parts with D_[a,b] defined by support truncation and unchanged W(h).

Scalar fBm on [0,1], H=1/3 inside the main range. Interval [1/2,1], F=B_(1/2), G=1, h=1_(1/2,1]. Smooth cylindrical class permits linear functions and constants. Half-open indicator convention represents the same continuous Gaussian increments.
